description: Manages updates and bundles with the swupd bundle manager, which is used by the Clear Linux Project for Intel Architecture.

parameters.name: contenturl
parameters.description: URL pointing to the contents of available bundles. If not specified, the contents are retrieved from clearlinux.org.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format suffix for version file downloads. For example 1, 2, 3, and so on, or the special value staging. If not specified, the default format is used.

parameters.name: manifest
parameters.description: The manifest contains information about the bundles at certain version of the OS. Specify a Manifest version to verify against that version or leave unspecified to verify against the current version.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the (I)bundle to install or remove.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates the desired (I)bundle state. present ensures the bundle is installed while absent ensures the (I)bundle is not installed. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: Updates the OS to the latest version. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Verify content for OS version. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Update the OS to the latest version
  community.general.swupd:
    update: true

- name: Installs the "foo" bundle
  community.general.swupd:
    name: foo
    state: present

- name: Removes the "foo" bundle
  community.general.swupd:
    name: foo
    state: absent

- name: Check integrity of filesystem
  community.general.swupd:
    verify: true

- name: Downgrade OS to release 12920
  community.general.swupd:
    verify: true
    manifest: 12920
